system.description: When you would deal damage to a creature their attempts to shield themselves were already a part of your calculations as you spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, If the damage you deal would be reduced by a creatures DR or applied to temporary hit points, the target must make a Constitution saving throw vs your attacks or Jutsu’s save DC (If Weapon/Unarmed, Taijutsu save DC) before damage calculation. On a failed save, they reduce the amount of DR or temporary hit points they have by an equal to twice the result of your Superiority Die until the end of the current turn.
